errors.wrong: with a place B over it whose inertia fixes L
errors.right: with a valuation subring B of Ω that satisfies IsPlaceOver B v and whose subgroup Ine B lies inside the fixing subgroup of L
errors.why: The Lean text has "IsPlaceOver B v" and places the subgroup named Ine under the bound "B ≤ L.fixingSubgroup", and the dossier shows no body for IsPlaceOver or Ine, so the words place and inertia assert a meaning for these two names without keeping the names beside them.
